name: keel-progress
description: Shows the live keel runs inside Claude Code: one line per run above the prompt and a /keel-progress pane, read from `keel status --json` and `keel activity --json`. Read-only; it never drives a run.

poll_seconds.title: Refresh every (seconds)
poll_seconds.description: How often to read keel's state while a run is live; with no live run it reads five times less often. keel status runs only when a checkpoint changed (or every 30 s while a run is live), so this is cheap.

band_rows.title: Runs above the prompt
band_rows.description: How many runs the band shows before '+N more' ('more' lists them all).

notify.title: Notifications
notify.description: Show a toast when a run stops, waits for you, or leaves the board.

sound.title: Sound
sound.description: Play a short sound with those notifications.

all_sessions.title: Show other sessions' runs
all_sessions.description: Off: a session shows only its own keel runs, in its folder and the worktrees keel made under it. On: every recently active worktree of the repository, as before (this costs a read per worktree).
